pattern.short_summary: Two or more display regions show the same underlying items under different encodings, and a correspondence between them is maintained and made visible.
pattern.definition: Two or more display regions show the same underlying items under different encodings, and a correspondence between them is maintained and made visible. Acting on an element in one region changes the rendering of its counterpart in the others. The correspondence is the interface's claim: nothing shown in one view is orphaned from its counterpart elsewhere.
pattern.structural_signature: A set of items has more than one simultaneous rendering, and the system holds an identity mapping between renderings. A selection, brush, or hover event in region A triggers a rendering change (highlight, filter, scroll, annotation) on the mapped elements in region B, with the mapping stable across interactions. As clustered, the category also contains members where the correspondence is a fixed link from an output element to its source span rather than an interactive coordination — see the review flag.

dimension.category_description: How evidence, internals, correspondence, quality, interpretations, and planned actions are represented for human judgment.
dimension.classification_boundary: The representation must support understanding or verification, rather than merely render output into a usable medium.
